newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Colruyt plunges in technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Colruyt plunges in technical correction.

text.p: Shares in Belgian retailer Colruyt plunged more than three percent on Wednesday with dealers putting it down to a correction from recent rises.
By 1130 GMT it was down 500 francs, or 3.26 percent, at 14,825 francs with a volume of 18.7 million Belgian francs of shares.
"Colruyt has gone up too quickly and too fast which was not fundamentallly justified," said one trader.
"I see a trading range of between 13,800 and 14,800 francs," he added.
Another dealer said this was a normal reaction after recent sharp rises. On Tuesday it set an all-time record close at 15,325 francs.
"It is a sound reaction," he said.
-- Paul de Bendern, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6817, Fax +32 2 230 7710
